title: Base Power grid switch
description: A centred heading under a torn-tape label, then a big rounded grey card: an illustration on the left and, on the right, a pill switch (lime ON, grey OFF) above a heading and a short text. Flipping the switch slides the knob and crossfades the illustration and the text to the other state. Phones put the illustration on top.
notes: two states, each with its own illustration slot (contained)
CSS only: a checkbox and :has() selectors; starts switched on
name: basepowercompany-grid-switch
